description: Statistical properties that correct analysis output must satisfy. Use these to evaluate the pipeline output and diagnose errors.

criteria.check: All 6 singular values must be strictly positive and in strictly descending order
All 6 squared covariance fractions must be in (0, 1) and their total must not exceed 1.0
The 6x6 rotation matrix R must satisfy R^T R = I within tolerance 1e-5
All 6 rotated variance fractions must be strictly positive, in descending order, and sum to 1.0 within tolerance 1e-5
The first (leading) rotated mode should capture at least 20% of total rotated variance
All 6 cross-correlation values must lie in [-1, 1]
The cross-correlation magnitude for the leading rotated mode should exceed 0.5
Rotation matrix must differ substantially from the identity matrix (max absolute deviation > 0.01)
